text:
Mexico has approved the appointment of Reno Omokri as Nigeria’s ambassador to the country, paving the way for him to assume the diplomatic role following months of waiting for formal clearance.
Omokri announced the development in a post on X on Tuesday, saying the Chargé d’Affaires of the Mexican Embassy in Abuja, José Manuel Briseño Flores, had delivered the diplomatic approval, known as agrément, to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
He said the approval was formally conveyed to the ministry’s Director of Protocol, Ambassador Babagana Wakil.
Omokri is also to serve as Nigeria’s ambassador to Guatemala, Honduras and Nicaragua under concurrent accreditation.
In his post, he wrote, “To God be the glory, the Chargé d’affaires of the Embassy of the United Mexican States in Abuja, Mr José Manuel Briseño Flores, today in Abuja delivered the agrément from the Government of the United Mexican States accepting me, Bemigho Reno Omokri, to serve as Ambassador Extraordinaire and Plenipotentiary of the Federal Republic of Nigeria to the United Mexican States, with concurrent accreditation to the Republic of Guatemala, the Republic of Honduras, and the Republic of Nicaragua.”
President Bola Tinubu nominated Omokri for an ambassadorial position in November 2025 alongside several other nominees, including former Minister of Aviation, Femi Fani-Kayode, and former Chairman of the Independent National Electoral Commission, Mahmood Yakubu.
The Senate confirmed Omokri and other ambassadorial nominees in December 2025, while Tinubu approved the posting of 65 ambassadors-designate and high commissioners to their respective countries on March 6, 2026.

In August, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs disclosed that Mexico and Japan were among the countries yet to communicate formal acceptance of two outstanding ambassadorial appointments. The ministry said it was engaging the countries and expressed confidence that the approvals would be secured.
Omokri had earlier dismissed speculation that Mexico had rejected his appointment.
Speaking on Channels Television’s Politics Today in June, he attributed the delay to diplomatic procedures and preparations for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, which Mexico is co-hosting with the United States and Canada.
Agrément is the formal consent granted by a host country before a diplomat nominated by another country can be appointed as its ambassador.
Omokri previously served as a media aide to former President Goodluck Jonathan and is known for his political commentary.
